Alameda County Official Election Site

Observation of Election Processing

Transparency is a crucial component of free, fair, and functional elections. The Registrar of Voters welcomes members of the public to observe its operations. Watch election processes via live streams or in person at the Registrar’s office.

Alameda County Registrar of Voters is committed to ensuring that its website is accessible to people with disabilities. All the pages on our website will meet W3C WAI’s Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.1, Level AA conformance. Visit our Web Policy page for more information. Report any issues or feedback to our web team via this Contact Us Form.
